configuration.entity_hypotheses: all256 queries of same full-sentence source, T native firstnoun preserved; R literal span masks in same token sequence, no top3/NMS cutoff
configuration.joint: P_T(i)P_R(j) per edge, each candidate distribution softmax(native entity logodds), temperature1; not calibrated probability claim
configuration.multiple_references: factor star: T marginal pT_i * product_r sum_j pR_rj*(1-C_rij); reference scores recomputed in each update; no joint argmax pair assumed true
configuration.conflict: 1-(1-geo)*(1-target_color)*(1-reference_color), cap.95; unknown measurements give zero constraint, not trainable mass
configuration.spatial: camera_image LEFT/RIGHT only, directed graph endpoints used. Full eight-corner box projection positive-depth and in-frame; >=8 actual visible points in sourcebox; conservative interval contains projected box center and visible-pixel10/90quantile plus5percent projected width; opposite intervals separated by.02imagewidth and shared visible support/min(count)<=.1. No surface-as-full-boundary claim
configuration.color: actual calibrated/zbuffer visible raw-point pixels only; same sourcebox scaled.85/1/1.15;>=16points each, pixelspan >=.35of projectedwidth ANDheight each; exactlyone nonnegated measurable color word; stable alternative descriptor>=.45, requested<=.20, margin>=.30 across all supports. Distant hue>=.24cycle or black/white only. Confidence<=.95; absence alone never contradiction
configuration.reference_missing: never generates contradiction; all weak/missing measurements remain in336denominator
configuration.parameter_interface: last Linear of contrastive_align_projection_image 288->64 rank4 alpha4 LoRA,1408params; text head/backbone/all other weights frozen; all entity scores rerun
configuration.optimizer: Adam lr.0005 betas.9/.999 eps1e-8 weightdecay0, gradientcap1,source reset per input/variant
configuration.control: RGBshuffle permutes RGB values among fixed actuallyvisible points; endpointshuffle permutes reference column of spatial conflicts only; everything else fixed
configuration.before_GT: seal evidence and predictions, independent audit before one score; no grid or postGT method repair
configuration.stop: if loss decreases without balancedmIoU gain or TTA not above same-information direct joint, do not adopt fixed recipe

normalization.reason: Availability must not become a trainable UNKNOWN escape route.
normalization.rule: For each entity/variant, fixed known-candidate stratum = any positive conflict in its row/column. Source softmax(logodds) mass in known/unknown strata is fixed. Updated scores redistribute only within each stratum. No explicit learned UNKNOWN category or increase in unmeasured mass. Strata are frozen from observation conflicts, not GT.
normalization.readout: raw arms use the same stratum-normalized target marginal; joint arms additionally condition on 1-C factors. source initialization has exactly the native ordering.
normalization.caveat: Unmeasured hypotheses remain possible at fixed source mass; lack of contradiction is never a positive label. Raw native logodds are retained privately for audit. No assertion source strata are calibrated or correct.
